OR a cargo-vet audit
as substitute" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="60" width="205" x="995" y="270" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p1_pick" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="newest-per-major
(one version chosen per major line)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="55" width="300" x="580" y="365" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p1_response" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=middle;" value="4. Response returns the surviving versions.
Blocked versions are simply ABSENT — no row, no reason,
no annotation. The sparse-index protocol has no place for a
reason phrase, so cargo prints its own "no matching version"." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="480" x="410" y="440" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p1_consequence" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=middle;" value="/refusals exists for exactly this.
The index cannot carry the why, so the
proxy publishes it on a separate route:
code, package, version, filename, why_id." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="110" width="285" x="915" y="440" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="phase2" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#333333;strokeWidth=2;verticalAlign=top;align=left;fontStyle=1;fontSize=13;spacingLeft=12;" value="PHASE 2 — .crate DOWNLOAD (exercised by cargo build / check)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="470" width="830" x="390" y="600" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2_meta" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;align=center;fontStyle=1;" value="METADATA APPROVAL FIRST

index verdict, or an allowlist entry?" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="65" width="260" x="690" y="645" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2_refuse" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="REFUSED: not-index-approved
ZERO upstream fetches. ZERO plugin runs.
A download is never a place to review inline." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="65" width="225" x="980" y="645" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="p2_cksum" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="Digest verify

required_criterion (default safe-to-deploy),
and trusted_reviewers accepts the auditor?" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="270" x="1280" y="145" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="vet_yes" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="YES → skip AI review.
A human already read it.
A qualifying audit from a trusted
reviewer substitutes for the model." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="270" x="1280" y="255" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="vet_never" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="NEVER substitutes for the CVE line.
NEVER substitutes for the plugins.
Those check different things from
"a person read this source", and a
static trust database answers neither." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="105" width="270" x="1280" y="355" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="vet_note" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontSize=11;fontColor=#666666;spacingLeft=2;" value="The audit store is refreshed every
cargo_vet_sync_interval (default 1h)
from every configured source.
Empty sources leave the fast path
with no proof to consult." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="90" width="270" x="1280" y="475" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="notes" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#666666;" value="TWO THINGS THE SHAPE HIDES" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="320" x="40" y="740" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="note_flag" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=middle;" value="THE plugin_checked COLUMN
A stored Clean row can mean either "the index
admitted this version" or "the plugins were run
and passed over these bytes". Only the
plugin_checked flag means the second. Without it
a Clean row is an admission, not a scan — and it
still owes the Phase 2 gates." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="120" width="320" x="40" y="770" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="note_allow" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=10;align=left;spacingLeft=8;verticalAlign=middle;" value="THE ALLOWLIST OVERRIDES
CVE, release age, AI review and plugin blocks.
It never overrides the cksum.

4. Response returns the surviving versions.
Blocked versions are simply ABSENT — no row, no reason,
no annotation. The sparse-index protocol has no place for a
reason phrase, so cargo prints its own "no matching version".

NEVER substitutes for the CVE line.
NEVER substitutes for the plugins.
Those check different things from
"a person read this source", and a
static trust database answers neither.

div.div:
THE plugin_checked COLUMN
A stored Clean row can mean either "the index
admitted this version" or "the plugins were run
and passed over these bytes". Only the
plugin_checked flag means the second. Without it
a Clean row is an admission, not a scan — and it
still owes the Phase 2 gates.

div.div:
THE ALLOWLIST OVERRIDES
CVE, release age, AI review and plugin blocks.
It never overrides the cksum.
Digest verification is not policy that an
operator can waive: it answers whether these
bytes are the bytes the index described.

div.div: The invariant: no .crate bytes are served for a version the index gate did not admit, and no version is admitted until CVE, release age and AI review (or a qualifying cargo-vet audit) have all passed it.
